sections.text:
The protection relay for main generator GPU-2000R is a multifunction relay 
 manufactured by ABB and this relay is a digital type. differential & phase 
 time over current & phase instantaneous

Voltage controlled time & Loss of excitation & over voltage & volts / Hertz & 
 distance / impedance & stator ground fault inadvertent energize & phase 
 unbalance / negative sequence & over frequency fault function are utilized

The first draft initiated by eng.Tarik Abd Elmegeed, tested by eng. Abd 
 Elhafez Farghaly, at 5 July 2008, 
 and accepted by General Manager Eng. Saliem Ahmed Ali and approved by Eng. 
 Abd Elnabi Abd Elghani Head 
 Sector of High 
 Dam PS station HPGC.

items: A work permit must be issued

The maintenance staff should be 
 trained, qualified, and carry the suitable safety ID category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Block out of service is required

Make sure all block test switches 
 are out

Ensure all CT path elements are 
 secure after any test disturbance
Double F6150 test set

Laptop with ECP relay software 
 downloaded
Voltmeter, test plug and test leads
Review the manual and drawings
Prepare the previous or commissioning results of the relay testing
Check the wires of the relay by hand
Check the AC source is available to the tester
Check the existence of the DC sources in panels

Insert the test plug into current & voltage test switches and connect it to 
 the tester according to the drawing and scheme
Check all the leads used in tests

Make the connections as shown in figure1, for the neutral phase a current 
 transformer

Set the timer to start upon application of current and to stop when the 
 contact monitor senses a closed contact
Apply the minimum current (0.2)A

The "pickup" LED on the relay should light and the contact should indicate a 
 closed contact
The "Differential" LED should also light
The time for a differential trip should be approximately two (2) cycles

Repeat the above testes for the neutral phase B and the neutral phase C 
 current transformers
Test the load side of the differential circuit

Repeat the above tests for the load phase A current transformer using the 
 connections as shown in figure 1

Repeat the tests using the load phase B and the load phase C current 
 transformer

sections.text: The 51 P Phase Time Over Current Function

items: Make the connection as shown in figure 1, for phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Set a single phase of current to 6 amperes RMS

Set the timer to start upon application of current and to stop when the 
 contact monitor senses a closed contact

Apply the current to the relay. The "pickup" Led should be lit and the unit 
 should trip in 4.00 seconds 7% the "over current / impedance" LED should be 
 lit
Repeat the test for the remaining phases listed as shown in figure 1

sections.text:
The (50P Phase Instantaneous & 51 VC Voltage 
Controlled Time) Over Current Function

items: Make the connections as shown in figure 1, for the phase to be tested

Apply a balance 3-phase voltage of 40 phase voltage of volts RMS phase to 
 neutral
Set a single phase of current to 6 amperes RMS

Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "over current" LED should be flashing
Make the connections as shown in figure 1, for the phase to be tested

Apply a balance 3-phase voltage of 57 phase to neutral volts RMS and set a 
 3-phase of current to 3 ampere RMS with a phase angle of 90" leading

Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact

The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "loss of excitation" LED should be 
 flashing
Make the connections as shown in figure 2, for the phase to be tested
Apply a single-phase voltage of 57 volts RMS to the relay
Slowly increase only the tested phase's voltage from 76 voltage RMS

The "pickup" LED is lit. This should occur when the voltage reaches 753% 
 volts RMS. The relay should trip in 1 second later

The contact monitor should indicate a closed contact and the "voltage - 
 volts/Hertz" Led should be lit
Repeat the above test with a balanced 3-phase voltage

Examine the operation records. All of the tests are indicated by a "59 trip" 
 event
Make the connections as shown in figure 2, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral

Slowly increase the voltage and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact

The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "voltage-volts/hertz" LED should be 
 flashing
Make the connections as shown in figure 1, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 10 volts RMS phase to neutral

Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact

The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "over current / impedance" LED should 
 be flashing
Make the connections as shown in figure 5, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Apply a volts RMS at 50 hertz representing the V

Slowly increase the voltage V and to stop when the contact monitor 
 senses a closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "stator ground" LED should be flashing

items: Make the connections as shown in figure 5, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Apply a volts RMS at 150 hertz representing the V
Set a volts Vo.to 4 volt

Slowly decrease the voltage Vo and to stop when the contact monitor senses a

The "pickup" LED should be lit
Make the connections as shown in figure 1, for the phase to be tested

Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
The protection relay for main generator GPU-2000R is a multifunction relay 
 manufactured by ABB and this relay is a digital type. differential & phase 
 time over current & phase instantaneous
Voltage controlled time & Loss of excitation & over voltage & volts / Hertz & 
 distance / impedance & stator ground fault inadvertent energize & phase 
 unbalance / negative sequence & over frequency fault function are utilized
The first draft initiated by eng.Tarik Abd Elmegeed, tested by eng. Abd 
 Elhafez Farghaly, at 5 July 2008, 
 and accepted by General Manager Eng. Saliem Ahmed Ali and approved by Eng. 
 Abd Elnabi Abd Elghani Head 
 Sector of High 
 Dam PS station HPGC.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should be 
 trained, qualified, and carry the suitable safety ID category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Block out of service is required
Make sure all block test switches 
 are out
Ensure all CT path elements are 
 secure after any test disturbance
Tools 
and Equipment

carried out

Check all the leads used in tests
Make the connections as shown in figure1, for the neutral phase a current

Set the timer to start upon application of current and to stop when the 
 contact monitor senses a closed contact
Apply the minimum current (0.2)A
The "pickup" LED on the relay should light and the contact should indicate a 
 closed contact
The "Differential" LED should also light
The time for a differential trip should be approximately two (2) cycles
Repeat the above testes for the neutral phase B and the neutral phase C 
 current transformers
Test the load side of the differential circuit
Repeat the above tests for the load phase A current transformer using the 
 connections as shown in figure 1
Repeat the tests using the load phase B and the load phase C current 
 transformer
The 51 P Phase Time Over Current Function
Make the connection as shown in figure 1, for phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Set a single phase of current to 6 amperes RMS
Set the timer to start upon application of current and to stop when the 
 contact monitor senses a closed contact
Apply the current to the relay. The "pickup" Led should be lit and the unit 
 should trip in 4.00 seconds 7% the "over current / impedance" LED should be 
 lit
Repeat the test for the remaining phases listed as shown in figure 1
The (50P Phase Instantaneous & 51 VC Voltage 
Controlled Time) Over Current Function
Make the connections as shown in figure 1, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance 3-phase voltage of 40 phase voltage of volts RMS phase to 
 neutral
Set a single phase of current to 6 amperes RMS
Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "over current" LED should be flashing
The 40 Loss of Excitation Function
Make the connections as shown in figure 1, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance 3-phase voltage of 57 phase to neutral volts RMS and set a 
 3-phase of current to 3 ampere RMS with a phase angle of 90" leading
Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "loss of excitation" LED should be 
 flashing
The 59 Over Voltage Function
Make the connections as shown in figure 2, for the phase to be tested
Apply a single-phase voltage of 57 volts RMS to the relay
Slowly increase only the tested phase's voltage from 76 voltage RMS
The "pickup" LED is lit. This should occur when the voltage reaches 753% 
 volts RMS. The relay should trip in 1 second later
The contact monitor should indicate a closed contact and the "voltage - 
 volts/Hertz" Led should be lit
Repeat the above test with a balanced 3-phase voltage
Examine the operation records. All of the tests are indicated by a "59 trip"

The 24 Volts/Hertz Function
Make the connections as shown in figure 2, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Slowly increase the voltage and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "voltage-volts/hertz" LED should be 
 flashing
The 21-1a Distance / Impedance Function
Make the connections as shown in figure 1, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 10 volts RMS phase to neutral
Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "over current / impedance" LED should 
 be flashing
The 59G Stator Ground Fault Function
Make the connections as shown in figure 5, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Apply a volts RMS at 50 hertz representing the V
Slowly increase the voltage V and to stop when the contact monitor

The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "stator ground" LED should be flashing
The 27G Stator Ground 3rd Harm Under 
Voltage Fault Function
Make the connections as shown in figure 5, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Apply a volts RMS at 150 hertz representing the V
Set a volts Vo.to 4 volt
Slowly decrease the voltage Vo and to stop when the contact monitor senses a

The "pickup" LED should be lit
The 50IE Inadvertent Energization Function
Make the connections as shown in figure 1, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance three- phase voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Apply a balance three-phase current of 3 amperes RMs at 50 HZ
Change the frequency setting to 46 Hz to the voltage and to stop when the 
 contact monitor senses a closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "reverse power" and the "over current / 
 impedance" LED should be flashing
The 46 Phase Unbalance / Negative Sequence 
Function
Make the connections as shown in figure 2, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance three - phase voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Set a single - phase current to 0.4 amperes RMS
Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "phase unbalance" LED should be

The 81 Over Frequency Function
Make the connections as shown in figure 2, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance three - phase voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral at

Slowly increase the frequency and to stop when the contact monitor senses a

The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "frequency" LED should be flashing
Restoring the Relay into Service
Return relay to service by removing the test plugs, and switch on test 
 switches

sections_ar.text: جهاز وقاية المولد الرئيسي GPU-2000R هو جهاز وقاية متعدد الوظائف من تصنيع ABB، وهو من النوع الرقمي. الوقاية التفاضلية وزيادة التيار الزمني للطور واللحظي للطور

وتُستخدم وظائف زيادة التيار الزمني المتحكم فيها بالجهد، وفقد الإثارة، وزيادة الجهد، والفولت/هرتز، والمسافة/المعاوقة، والعطل الأرضي للعضو الثابت، والتغذية غير المقصودة، وعدم اتزان الطور/التتابع السالب، وزيادة التردد

أعد المسودة الأولى م. Tarik Abd Elmegeed، واختبرها م. Abd Elhafez Farghaly، في 5 July 2008، وقبلها المدير العام م. Saliem Ahmed Ali، واعتمدها م. Abd Elnabi Abd Elghani رئيس قطاع محطة السد العالي PS station HPGC.

مقدمة
جهاز وقاية المولد الرئيسي GPU-2000R هو جهاز وقاية متعدد الوظائف من تصنيع ABB، وهو من النوع الرقمي. الوقاية التفاضلية وزيادة التيار الزمني للطور واللحظي للطور
وتُستخدم وظائف زيادة التيار الزمني المتحكم فيها بالجهد، وفقد الإثارة، وزيادة الجهد، والفولت/هرتز، والمسافة/المعاوقة، والعطل الأرضي للعضو الثابت، والتغذية غير المقصودة، وعدم اتزان الطور/التتابع السالب، وزيادة التردد
أعد المسودة الأولى م. Tarik Abd Elmegeed، واختبرها م. Abd Elhafez Farghaly، في 5 July 2008، وقبلها المدير العام م. Saliem Ahmed Ali، واعتمدها م. Abd Elnabi Abd Elghani رئيس قطاع محطة السد العالي PS station HPGC.
